reviews.text: Selecting Pool Xperts to take our vision and transform our backyard into an oasis was an incredible experience. We set very high expectations, and they didn't disappoint, going above and beyond every step of the way. Their beautiful showroom provided a place to see full size samples of materials and products. Our salesperson Tim's expertise provided valuable feedback in helping us with our selections to ensure everything turned out perfect. Once the project started, Alain the owner, was onsite everyday overseeing every step of the build. We asked for several changes in the middle of the project and he handled them effortlessly. After only 8 weeks we now have a stunning backyard that we are proud to share with family and friends and create the special memories. If you're looking for a pool builder, you must give Pool Xperts a call. Alain and his team treated us like family and not just another customer.
reviews.author: Jeff Carroll

reviews.text:
**Outstanding Pool Builder Experience**

I recently had the pleasure of working with Pool Xperts for the construction of my new pool, and I couldn't be more thrilled with the result. From start to finish, the entire process was seamless and professional.

The initial consultation with Tim was thorough and informative. He took the time to understand my vision and provided valuable insights that enhanced my ideas. Their expertise was evident as they walked me through every detail, from design options to material choices and at no point did we feel pressured or get any kind of “sales pitch.”

Throughout the construction phase, Alain and his team displayed exceptional craftsmanship and dedication. They adhered to the timeline and budget, and their attention to detail was remarkable. The communication was top-notch, with regular updates and prompt responses to any questions I had.

The finished pool exceeded my expectations. It’s not just a beautiful addition to my property, but also a testament to Pool Xperts skill and commitment to quality. The project was completed ahead of schedule with minimal disruption, and the site was left clean and organized.

I highly recommend Pool Xperts to anyone considering a pool project. Their professionalism, expertise, and dedication to customer satisfaction set them apart from the competition. Thank you, Pool Xperts, for making our dream pool a reality!

Alain (Pool Xperts, Owner). Alain is outstanding! Professional in every aspect. He goes above and beyond to meet the needs of his customers. Throughout the pool building process, Alain would show up on site to speak with the different crews. On a few occasions, he was not afraid to get his hands dirty to make sure all was in order. Tim (pool design/pricing). Tim designed our pool. He patiently guided us through the process as he took the time to understand our vision. He offered helpful advice and was diligent in making modifications along the way. Tim’s pool design made our dreams a reality!

Steve (Onsite Manager). Steve is exceptional! Steve personally inspected each phase of work to ensure the quality of work was acceptable and within code compliance. Steve made sure to keep me in the loop regarding scheduling, start/completion dates/times, and delays. Truly professional, sincere, and honest. I enjoyed the many conversations we had.

Guadalupe “Lupe” (Service Manager). Lupe is a pool “GURU”! Very detailed and knowledgeable about his work. Learning how to operate, maintain, and troubleshoot any new system has its challenges. Lupe is a great instructor, and he made the learning process easier. Not only is he thorough with the information he delivers but he is patient! Taking that extra time to make certain customers understand the step-by-step process. He was able to answer my questions promptly and with ease. My knowledge of the pool system enhanced each time we spoke.

Thank you All!

reviews.text: Pool Xperts are fantastic and we highly recommend them for their professionalism, excellent sales and selection process, installation and beautiful finished product. From Tim the salesman, Steve the Project Mgr. and their office staff, we could not be happier. Alain the owner also checked in periodically, on the installation and answer questions. We had piece of mind knowing that they used auger anchors to tie the pool deep into the ground, to limit any potential movement or shifting. The installation likewise, was high quality and we could not be happier with the final result. The hand-hewn stone coping around the pool and spa is beautiful, as is the ocean blue color of plaster that we chose. We chose a turn-key install, which included stamping and staining the concrete decking, along with our existing patio. This turned out great as well. They re-routed our sprinkler system and installed fresh sod, which left a final grade which was better than the builder had originally. They reinstalled our fence, which turned out nice. I also love having the APP on my phone to control the lights, spa and monitor the system as a whole. Over the years, we've learned that you get what you pay for, and so when builders come in with a much lower price, you should question where they are cutting corners. With other companies leaving projects uncompleted these days, it's nice knowing that a quality company like Pool Xperts is there to provide an excellent product for a fair price.
reviews.author: Bob Smith

data.summary: Reviews show strong evidence of authentic customer experiences, including specific details and a credible negative complaint. However, the duplication of several 5-star reviews across Google profiles suggests some review manipulation or copying. The company demonstrates good follow-through in some cases but poor warranty response in others.
fake_signals: Identical 5-star reviews posted on both Google Maps profiles (Local and HQ)
Highly similar language and structure in multiple 5-star reviews
Lack of 3-4 star reviews in the sampled data

negative_evidence: Owner unresponsive to repair requests for grout, plaster, and stone cracks
Owner blamed chemicals instead of honoring work
positive_evidence: Steve returned and remodeled a completed pool feature
Allen and service manager fixed a light issue

authentic_signals: Specific employee names mentioned (Tim, Alain, Lupe, Steve)
Emotional authenticity in the negative review
Varied project types (new build, repairs, grout, lights)
complaint_patterns: Quality issues post-completion (grout, plaster, stone cracks)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are generally high and consistent. The Yelp rating is slightly lower but based on only 5 reviews, which is not statistically significant for a discrepancy.
